message.content: {"question": "3. A 6.0-L flask contains a mixture of methane, argon, and helium at 45°C and 1.75 atm. If the mole fractions of helium and argon are 0.25 and 0.35, respectively, how many molecules of methane are present?", "options": {"A": "0.97x10^23", "B": "6.02x10^23", "C": "0.30x10^-23", "D": "7.03x10^-12", "E": "None of these choices is correct"}, "correct": "A"}
